formulas.formula: Keep your remodel on budget, on schedule and surprise-proof.
Project: total budget, how much to hold back for surprises (10-20%), square feet and start date.
Quotes: compare up to 3 bids per trade. Pick the one you chose.
Budget: every line item with estimate, actual and what you've paid. Payments: your contractor's draw schedule.
Selections: finishes with lead times. The sheet tells you when to order so nothing holds up the job.
Change Orders: every extra the contractor asks for. Timeline: phases with dates and done ticks.
Remodels almost always find surprises. Keep 10-20% in reserve.
And compare what each one includes, not just the price.
Cabinets and tile can take 6-12 weeks. Watch the order-by dates.
Approve them in writing before the work happens.

=IF(R5<0,"Over budget by "&TEXT(-R5,"$#,##0")&". Look for swaps on the Budget tab.",IF(R8>0,R8&IF(R8=1," item needs"," items need")&" ordering soon (Selections).",IF(R9>0,R9&IF(R9=1," payment is"," payments are")&" due soon or overdue (Payments).",IF(R12>0,R12&IF(R12=1," phase is"," phases are")&" running late (Timeline).","On budget and on track."))))
Expected = actual price once you have it, otherwise the estimate. Over / under compares actual to estimate.
Type each contractor's name in the grey row, then their bid for each trade. Green = lowest bid.
If you took every lowest bid
Order by = needed date minus lead time. Order early: delays here hold up the whole job.
Extras and surprises the contractor bills for. Only approved ones count.
Each phase with a start date and how many days it takes.
